I am a PhD student in the Department of Biology at the University of Oxford. I am interested in the nexus of wetland ecology, nature markets, and nature-based solutions.

I use this site to write about my projects, post notes and ideas, and host interactive tools I have developed.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" icon=false}
**Featured project:** [Permanence Risks to Biodiversity and Nature-Based Carbon Offsets](projects/offset-permanence/index.qmd) —
we recently published a review along with an interactive database of the risks we identified.
:::

## Research interests

{{< include _content/research-interests.md >}}

## Currently

- Working withthe National Wetland Condition Assessment (NWCA) data to understand drivers of wetland condition in the United States.
- Testing applications of geospatial foundation models for predicting wetland condition.

We also recently published a review of permanence risks biodiversity and nature-based carbon offsets: see the [project page](projects/offset-permanence/index.qmd) and the [project repository](https://github.com/alexdhond/offset-permanence-review).
